candidates.change_summary: Change supportsInterface to return false for IERC1155MetadataURI interface id by removing that check (so it returns true only for IERC1155 and otherwise defers to super).
Change the require that checks account non-zero to instead return 0 without reverting when account is the zero address.
Change the zero-address check to instead require account != address(this), so balanceOf allows queries for address(0) but disallows querying the contract's own address.

Change the loop to use <= in condition so it iterates one past end (out-of-bounds access removed by using safe min length) — replaced loop condition to i <= accounts.length-1 which changes returned array when ids length < accounts length by reading fewer elements.

Change the function to compute balances into a smaller array sized by ids.length instead of accounts.length, altering the returned array when lengths differ (the require still enforces equality in original, so this changes behavior if require bypassed by contract changes).
Replace the call to balanceOf with direct mapping access to bypass the require that account != address(0), which changes returned values for zero-address entries.
Invert the order of indexing when reading balances so it returns balances for (id, account) swapped to (account, id) causing incorrect values.
Modify the function to return cumulative balances up to each index (prefix sum) instead of the per-index balances, changing returned array values.
